resources.string: "v1.22.0 • Added an Android home screen widget with playback controls and resizable layouts. • Added Track history with copying and TXT export. • Sleep timer and Track history are now available from the control panel menu. • Sleep timer can now remain visible when inactive. Its options are in Settings. • Starting or stopping the sleep timer now returns to the previous screen. • Playback indicator animation can now be turned off in Settings. • Fixed favorite icons changing color when opening the side menu. • Default app volume is now 100%. • Internal improvements and component updates."
"v1.17.1 • Fixed the default sorting for new playlists. Stations are now sorted by date added, newest first."

"v1.17.0 • The app now supports playlists. Stations can now be grouped into playlists, each with its own tab. • Each tab remembers its own sorting. • Tabs can be rearranged. • Favorite icons (hearts) and the playback animation can now be hidden. Check out Settings. • JSON backups now include playlists, tab order, and sorting for each list. • JSON and TXT imports now accept only their respective formats. • Clearing the library now also removes playlists and resets sorting and tab order. • Fixed an issue where removing tracking parameters could alter other parts of a station URL."

"v1.12.0 • A Sleep timer is now available. With a movable on-screen countdown. • Station lists now support customizable dividers. Check out Settings. • Release notes can now be viewed in the What’s new window. • The Check for updates button in About (only in GitHub releases) has a new look. • Internal improvements and component updates."
